description: After one vulnerability is confirmed, find its siblings: extract the root cause, generalize it in steps (exact, structural, semantic), search the codebase and its history with grep, Semgrep, and manual tracing, and record coverage so the hunt has a stopping point. Use when a bug was just fixed or reported and you need to know where else the same mistake exists, or when turning a CVE or advisory into a codebase-wide check. Not for first-pass auditing (use security-code-review) or deciding if one finding is real (use vulnerability-validation).
